name: post-tool-use-todowrite-complete
description: A Claude Code PostToolUse hook for TodoWrite whose tool_input.todos are ALL status 'completed' carries a semantic boundary (`todos_complete`) — the closest thing an agent emits to 'the plan is done', and an arc the session may well continue past. The tool itself is not in the classification table, so it stays unknown/other (dumb by design) and, being neither a shell nor a VCS category, captures no outcome even though tool_response is populated; nothing here earns a salience hint either. Reading the todo list is not the adapter growing judgment: it reports a state the host handed over verbatim.
